items.title: 9.9.2 Titration curve aur equivalence point (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.9.2, printed pages 206-208.

blocks.title: pH curve aur equivalence point
blocks.text: pH curve (titration curve) shamil kiye gaye titrant ke hajm ke muqable solution ke pH ka graph hai. Equivalence point woh nuqta hai jahan shamil titrant ki miqdar analyte solution ko poori tarah neutralise karne ke liye bilkul kaafi ho. Titration ka end point tab hota hai jab indicator rang badalta hai; aisa indicator chuna jata hai jis ka end point equivalence point ke qareeb ho.

Titration curves dikhate hain ke tezabi ya basic solution ka pH basic ya tezabi solution shamil karne par kaise badalta hai, aur un se aisa indicator chuna jata hai jo dikhaye ke titration mukammal ho gaya.

HCl ki NaOH se titration par ghaur karein. Shuru mein solution mein sirf strong acid hai, jo poori tarah dissociate hota hai, to [H+] zyada aur pH bohat kam hai. Jaise NaOH shamil hota hai, OH- ions HCl ke H+ ions ko neutralise karte hain aur pH barhta hai. Equivalence point tab aata hai jab shamil OH- ki miqdar asal mein maujood H+ ke stoichiometric taur par barabar ho; equivalence point par pH 7.0 hai. Yahan curve tez izafa dikhata hai, tezabi se neutral tezi se badalta hua, end point par pH taqreeban 4.0 se 10.0 tak badalta hai. Chunke in titrations ka equivalence par pH 7.0 hai, phenolphthalein indicator ke taur par istemal ho sakta hai, kyunke yeh is range mein mukhtalif rang dikhata hai.

blocks.alt: Titration curve: pH (0 se 14) ke muqable shamil kiye gaye strong base ka hajm (0 se 80 mL), nuqton ke saath. pH taqreeban 1 se shuru ho kar aahista barhta hai, 40 mL par taqreeban seedha oopar chhalang lagata hai aur 12.5 ke qareeb thehar jata hai. Dashed lakeer 'pH = 7.00 at equivalence point'. Tez hisse par rangeen pattiyan phenolphthalein (taqreeban pH 8.2 se 10) aur methyl red (taqreeban pH 4.4 se 6.2), flasks ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.3: Strong acid-strong base titration curve (kitab ki Figure 9.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Shuru mein pH taqreeban 1 hai kyunke sirf strong acid hai. 40 mL par sab acid neutralise ho jata hai aur pH 4 se 10 tak achanak uchhalta hai, equivalence point par 7.00. Phenolphthalein (8.2 se 10) aur methyl red (4.4 se 6.2) dono ki range is seedhe hisse mein hai, is liye dono kaam kar sakte hain.

Aabi NH3 ki HCl se titration par ghaur karein. Shuru mein solution mein sirf weak base hai, jo juzvi taur par dissociate hota hai, strong base se kam OH- concentration deta hua; ibtidai pH 7 se zyada magar strong base se kam hai. Jaise HCl shamil hota hai OH- concentration ghat-ti aur pH girta hai. Equivalence point se pehle solution buffer jaise ilaqe mein hai jahan pH zyada aahista badalta hai: weak base aur us ka conjugate acid (bane hue salt se) buffering asar paida karte hain jo pH ki tabdeeli ko narm karta hai. Equivalence point par pH 7 se kam (pH = 5.27) hai kyunke conjugate acid thora dissociate hota hai, NH4+ se NH3 + H+, solution ko tezabi karte hue. Equivalence point ke baad pH tezi se girta hai, kyunke strong acid poori tarah dissociate ho kar H+ ki zyada concentration deta hai. Methyl orange is range mein rang badalta hai, to yeh strong acid-weak base titrations ka indicator hai.

blocks.alt: Titration curve: pH (0 se 14) ke muqable shamil kiye gaye HCl(aq) ka hajm (0 se 80 mL). pH taqreeban 11 se shuru ho kar 'buffer region' mein aahista girta hai (curve ke saath gulabi patti, jo phenolphthalein ki range bhi hai), 40 mL par tezi se girta hai aur 1.5 ke qareeb thehar jata hai. Dashed lakeerein taqreeban pH 9.2 aur 'pH = 5.27 at equivalence point' par. Methyl red ki patti tez girawat ko kaat-ti hai, flask ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.4: Strong acid-weak base titration curve (kitab ki Figure 9.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Shuru mein pH taqreeban 11 hai (kamzor base). Buffer region mein pH aahista girta hai, is liye phenolphthalein ki range (gulabi patti) yahan dheere dheere guzar jati hai aur munasib nahi. Equivalence point par pH 5.27 hai (NH4+ thora tezabi), aur methyl red ki patti tez girawat par hai, is liye yahan woh behtar hai.

blocks.prompt: End point aur equivalence point mein farq batayein, aur strong acid-strong base curve par equivalence point kaise dhundein (Quick Check 9.6a; Q.7).
blocks.explanation: Equivalence point wahan hai jahan titrant ne analyte ko bilkul neutralise kar diya, ek stoichiometric haqeeqat; end point wahan jahan indicator rang badalta hai, ek mushahida jo us ke jitna qareeb mumkin ho chuna jata hai. HCl-NaOH curve par equivalence point taqreeban amoodi hisse ka darmiyani nuqta hai, pH 7 par, jahan base ka ek qatra pH ko taqreeban 4 se 10 tak uchhal deta hai.

items: Titration curve: titrant ke hajm ke muqable pH; equivalence point = bilkul neutralisation; end point = indicator ka rang badalna, us ke qareeb chuna hua.

HCl NaOH ke saath: kam shuru, pH 4 se 10 tak tez chhalang equivalence 7 se guzarte hue; phenolphthalein. NH3 HCl ke saath: 7 se oopar shuru, buffer jaisi girawat, pH 5.27 par equivalence (NH4+ tezabi), baad mein tez girawat; methyl orange.
